orders_view_all_description: Every current order from your connected systems.
orders_view_outstanding_description: Open orders with units still to fulfill.
orders_view_overdue_description: Outstanding orders past the deadline set in their source.
orders_view_needs_you_description: Orders linked to an issue that needs your decision or review.
orders_view_differs_description: Orders whose status, payment, total, or ordered items differ between sources.
orders_summary_status_unknown: {source} doesn’t report a known status for this order.
orders_summary_remaining: {units, plural, one {{units, number} unit} other {{units, number} units}} still to fulfill across {lines, plural, one {{lines, number} line} other {{lines, number} lines}}.
orders_summary_remaining_unknown: Luma can’t tell how much remains on {lines, plural, one {{lines, number} line} other {{lines, number} lines}} because {source} doesn’t report current or reduced quantities. {fulfilled, number} of {ordered, plural, one {{ordered, number} unit is} other {{ordered, number} units are}} fulfilled.
orders_summary_fulfillment_failed_code: A fulfillment in {source} failed with code {code}.
orders_summary_needs_you: {count, plural, one {{count, number} issue needs you.} other {{count, number} issues need you.}}
orders_summary_open_issues: {count, plural, one {{count, number} linked issue is still open.} other {{count, number} linked issues are still open.}}
orders_list_search_placeholder: Order number, source ID, or SKU…
orders_list_offline: You’re offline. Reconnect to refresh orders.
orders_access_lost: You don’t have access to orders in this workspace. Ask a workspace admin for permission to view orders.
orders_list_page_mismatch: This page link no longer matches the filters. Start again from the first page.
orders_list_load_failed: Luma couldn’t load orders. Check your connection and try again.
orders_list_refresh_failed: Luma couldn’t refresh orders. The list below may be out of date.
orders_list_unmatched_body: Try another search, view, or filter. Orders that no connected system has reported yet don’t appear here.
orders_list_empty_body: Orders appear here once a connected store or ERP reports them.
orders_list_pagination_total: {count, plural, one {{count, number} order} other {{count, number} orders}}
orders_detail_offline: You’re offline. This order may be out of date.
orders_detail_missing: This order isn’t in this workspace, or no connected system reports it anymore.
orders_detail_load_failed: Luma couldn’t load this order. Check your connection and try again.
orders_detail_linked_notice: This order was linked to another source. You’re viewing the combined order, and each source’s data stays separate.
orders_detail_live_description: Payments, customer, fulfillment holds, returns, refunds, and events from {source}, read live with this connection’s permissions. Luma doesn’t store these details. The returns and refunds shown above are stored in Luma.
orders_inspector_no_issues: No issues are linked to this order.
orders_inspector_stock_syncing: Stock differs between sources while they sync. Raised as an issue if still open at {until}.
orders_inspector_issue_occurrences: {count, plural, one {{count, number} time} other {{count, number} times}}
orders_inspector_no_runs: No workflow has run for this order or its issues.
orders_inspector_source_times_unreported: Update time not reported · Last read {read}
orders_fulfillments_empty: No source has reported fulfillment work for this order.
orders_history_truncated: {count, plural, one {Showing the latest {count, number} entry.} other {Showing the latest {count, number} entries.}}
orders_activity_empty: Luma recorded no activity for this order in the last year.
orders_activity_truncated: {count, plural, one {Showing the latest {count, number} event.} other {Showing the latest {count, number} events.}}
orders_lines_empty: This source reports no order lines.
orders_link_search_hint: Search by order number to link an order Luma didn’t suggest.
orders_link_search_failed: Luma couldn’t search orders. Check your connection and try again.
orders_link_search_empty: No orders from another connection match this search.
orders_link_review_failed: Luma couldn’t load this order. Try reviewing it again.
orders_authority_missing: Source has no report for this order
orders_authority_not_configured: No authority rule for this fact
orders_comparison_pending_description: Differences remain pending until every source has been read after the 15-minute propagation window.
orders_comparison_inconclusive_descripti: The comparison needs fresh, complete reads and unambiguous line mappings. Unknown values do not prove a difference.
orders_comparison_lines_caption: Business state per mapped order line
orders_summary_overfulfillment: {source} reports {value} shipped units above the current quantity.
orders_sales_intro: Accept this Shopify order to keep an editable record in Luma. Select Luma ERP for order lines and lifecycle in source authority before editing.
orders_sales_authority: Choose Luma ERP for order lines and lifecycle in workspace source authority before editing.
orders_sales_error: The order could not be saved. Reload to check its version, source authority and your permissions.
orders_sales_unavailable: Luma order record is unavailable. Try again.
orders_charges_none_reported: {source} reports no delivery or charge details for this order.
orders_shipping_empty: This source reports no shipping charges.
orders_tax_empty: This source reports no tax lines.
orders_addresses_restricted: Addresses are customer data. Ask a workspace admin for permission to view customers to see them.
orders_addresses_not_shared: {source} isn’t approved to share addresses with Luma.
orders_plan_description: What a change still needs before every system shows it, whether it is still safe, and who does each step. Plans change nothing.
orders_plan_failed: The change plan couldn’t be loaded.
orders_plan_none_detected: The sources show no change to plan. Propose a quantity to see what it would take.
orders_plan_inconclusive: The source comparison is inconclusive, so Luma doesn’t plan detected changes yet. Propose a quantity to see what it would take.
orders_plan_hidden: You don’t have access to fulfillment, so Luma can’t tell you whether a change is still safe.
orders_plan_location_value: {count, plural, one {{count, number} location} other {{count, number} locations}}
orders_plan_safety_unknown_help: Luma never calls a change safe on missing, old or incomplete evidence.
orders_plan_reason_work_started: Fulfillment has started on this order.
orders_plan_reason_fulfilled_beyond_targ: More units have shipped than the new quantity.
orders_plan_reason_stale_evidence: An order or fulfillment read is more than five minutes old or lies in the future.
orders_plan_reason_incomplete_evidence: The latest read failed, was partial or stopped before its last page.
orders_plan_reason_ambiguous_line: Lines can’t be matched across sources without doubt.
orders_plan_reason_unknown_progress: Fulfillment progress isn’t known for this line.
orders_plan_reason_unknown_value: No authoritative source reports the intended value.
orders_plan_reason_authority_unknown: No source is the authority for this fact, or the authority doesn’t report this order.
orders_plan_reason_authority_conflict: More than one source could be the authority for this fact.
orders_plan_reason_no_fulfilment_source: No connected system reports fulfillment progress.
orders_plan_reason_fulfilment_hidden: You don’t have access to fulfillment.
orders_plan_ack_stale: Read more than five minutes ago
orders_plan_shipped_maximum: The largest count any source reports, from {source}. Mirrored shipments aren’t added.
orders_plan_shipped_unknown: No visible source reports shipments for this line.
orders_plan_steps_none: Every system already shows this change.
orders_plan_action_check_progress: Check how far fulfillment has progressed in {system}.
orders_plan_action_confirm_picking: Confirm in {system} that picking matches the new quantity, or adjust it.
orders_plan_action_stop_work: Stop or hold the work in {system}.
orders_plan_action_hold_for_address: Hold the parcel in {system} until its label shows the new address.
orders_plan_action_stop_and_reassign: Stop the work in {system} and hand it to the new location.
orders_plan_action_return_or_refund: Arrange a return or refund for the units already shipped.
orders_plan_action_reassign_location: Assign the new fulfilling location in {system}.
orders_plan_action_carrier_redirect: Ask the carrier to redirect the parcel.
orders_plan_action_notify_added_units: Tell the warehouse working in {system} about the added units.
orders_plan_action_notify_customer: Tell the customer what changes for their order.
orders_plan_action_escalate_unsafe: Decide how to continue: the change is no longer safe to carry through.
orders_plan_action_escalate_unknown: Decide how to continue once fulfillment progress is confirmed.
orders_plan_step_ready: Luma can run this after a preview and approval.
orders_plan_step_needs_permission: Luma can run this. Requesting it needs the permission “{permission}”.
orders_plan_blocked_not_granted: Not possible yet: the connection isn’t allowed to make this change.
orders_plan_blocked_unavailable: Not possible now: the connection isn’t available.
orders_plan_blocked_authority: Not possible: {system} isn’t the authority for order lines.
orders_plan_blocked_unmapped: Not possible: Luma can’t identify this line in {system}.
orders_plan_blocked_whole_units: Not possible: {system} accepts whole units only.
orders_plan_blocked_observe_only: Not possible now: Luma only observes. Writes are turned off.
orders_plan_blocked_unsafe: Waits until the steps above make the change safe.
orders_plan_blocked_unknown: Waits until fulfillment progress is known.
orders_plan_propose_invalid: Enter a quantity of zero or more, with up to six decimal places.
orders_plan_propose_no_lines: No line can be matched across sources, so Luma can’t plan a quantity change.
